arguments.code:
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

# Build playlist -> total duration seconds
playlist_lengths = {}
all_song_ids = set()
for p in all_playlists:
    all_song_ids.update(p.get('song_ids', []))

print('unique_song_count', len(all_song_ids))

# Cache durations per song_id
song_duration_sec = {}
for sid in sorted(all_song_ids):
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_duration_sec[sid] = s['duration']

# Sum per playlist
for p in all_playlists:
    total_sec = sum(song_duration_sec[sid] for sid in p.get('song_ids', []))
    playlist_lengths[p['playlist_id']] = {
        'title': p['title'],
        'total_sec': total_sec,
        'total_min': total_sec/60
    }

# Find shortest by total_sec
shortest = min(playlist_lengths.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]['total_sec'])
shortest_pid, shortest_info = shortest

minutes_decimal = Decimal(str(shortest_info['total_sec']))/Decimal('60')
rounded_minutes = int((minutes_decimal).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

print('shortest_playlist', shortest_info['title'], 'pid', shortest_pid)
print('total_sec', shortest_info['total_sec'])
print('total_min', float(shortest_info['total_min']))
print('rounded_minutes', rounded_minutes)

# Also print all playlist lengths for verification artifact
print('all_playlist_lengths')
for pid, info in sorted(playlist_lengths.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]['total_sec']):
    print(pid, info['title'], info['total_sec'], float(info['total_min']))
